high_level_description: A Warrior-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a black-haired academy prefect pivots on a stair landing and aims an enormous bazooka across the descending staircase.

style_description.aesthetics: playful fantasy academy combat, exaggerated weapon scale, expressive young adult anime characters with consistent slender proportions and elaborate uniform silhouettes
style_description.lighting: clear directional daylight, broad colored shadow shapes, restrained highlights on skin and sharp highlights along metal edges
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, expressive hand-drawn anime anatomy, fine tapered linework, angular cel shading, selective painted transitions and richly painted backgrounds

compositional_deconstruction.background: An academy stairwell is viewed from above, with strong zigzag railings and ivory steps. The huge launcher crosses the stair geometry on a contrasting diagonal. The prefect's trailing black hair and crimson ribbon describe her sharp turn.

elements.desc: A young adult academy girl with straight black hair and a severe focused expression pivots on one planted boot, gripping her immense shoulder bazooka with both hands as her jacket swings outward. She wears a navy sailor jacket, oversized ivory collar, crimson ribbon, gold star clasp, pleated skirt, opaque tights and reinforced boots.

An absurdly enormous crimson bazooka has a straight cylindrical launch tube longer than its wielder is tall and as thick as her torso. Broad ivory muzzle collars, stepped armor plates, a navy shoulder cradle, brass fasteners and a gold star crest define its heavy construction.
